summary_en: CERES INC. authorized acquisition of up to 1.25 million shares (10.83% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 2.5 billion yen through market purchases from October 2, 2026 to September 30, 2027, funded from proceeds of BitBank stock sale to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns toward ROE 15% target.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 1, 2026, CERES INC. announced a treasury stock acquisition plan authorized by its Board of Directors under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 1.25 million shares, representing 10.83% of outstanding shares (calculated from 1,250,000 shares divided by 11,542,912 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock), for a maximum of 2.5 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 2, 2026 through September 30, 2027.

The repurchase is funded from proceeds of the completed sale of CERES' entire shareholding in BitBank Inc., which was announced on June 25, 2026 along with a basic agreement on capital allocation prioritizing shareholder returns and growth investment. The company had previously disclosed on June 17, 2026 that it would pursue treasury stock acquisitions totaling approximately 5 billion yen (already completed) plus up to 2.5 billion yen using BitBank sale proceeds.

CERES stated that the acquisition serves to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns while ensuring achievement of the "ROE 15%" target outlined in its Medium-Term Business Plan 2030 (five-year plan). Execution of purchase orders is subject to market conditions and may be partially or fully withheld. As of September 30, 2026, CERES held 644,388 treasury shares against 11,542,912 shares outstanding.
